board: Purple AHT30 temperature & humidity sensor module (GY-style, 4-pin 2.54 mm header: VIN, GND, SCL, SDA; 662K 3.3 V LDO, 4.7 kOhm pull-ups, MOSFET level shifter)
reason: The part check passed on the first run on ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test (T=27.5C H=62%), circuit board with clean DRC, footprint and LCSC C45354925. The sim encodes the datasheet's 20-bit RH/T formulas and CRC-8 (0x31, init 0xFF), and the driver follows the AHT30 reading process: wait 5 ms, send 0xAC 0x33 0x00, wait 80 ms, read 7 bytes and poll on busy.
